body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction imposes an ordinary magical Condition on the target. Response (unopposed): Suppress that Condition until the start of your next turn. Specialty and Wound Conditions are unaffected.

surges.html: Suppress ordinary concealment penalties against the source for the target's next card until the start of your next turn.
The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
